title: TCC Group to publicly list Cimpor International Holdings
summary: Taiwan Cement to publicly list Cimpor International Holdings
body_markdown:
**Netherlands/Taiwan:** Taiwan Cement (TCC) has won shareholder approval for an overseas initial public offering of its Netherlands-registered subsidiary Cimpor International Holdings. China Times News has reported that shareholders representing 95% of attending shares approved the plan at an extraordinary general meeting on 13 October 2026.


TCC plans to separate Cimpor International Holdings, along with the group’s Portuguese, Turkish and African business, under TCC Dutch Holdings. It will then list the subsidiary on the Euronext international exchange or on the London Stock Exchange in the UK.
